component.name: Twinleaf
component.summary: Discover, plot, log, and configure Twinleaf quantum sensors

description.p: Twinleaf is a cross-platform GTK4 application for working with Twinleaf quantum sensors over the TIO protocol. It discovers devices, streams and plots their data live (time series and FFT), records to .tio logs, exports CSV/HDF5, plays back recordings, and configures sensors through their RPC interface.

screenshot.caption: Live plotting with per-channel sidebar and sensor settings
